data.name: Greg
data.gender_notes: Greg is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gregory derives from the Greek word 'gregoreo,' meaning 'to watch, to be alert.' As a Christian name, it is derived from the Latin form 'Gregorius,' which means 'watchful, guardian.'. The name Greg carries the meaning “Strong, watchful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Greg usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, watchful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Greg total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
